title: Guard the header
description:
`main.cpp` includes `settings.h` twice (in real projects this happens indirectly, through other headers). Because the header defines a constant, the second copy is a redefinition and the compiler stops.

Fix `settings.h` so that including it twice is harmless. Do not change `main.cpp`.

The program should print `3`.
hints: Put `#pragma once` on the first line of `settings.h`. It tells the compiler: paste this file at most once per source file.
rules: Add a header guard to settings.h.
Leave both include lines in main.cpp.
